packageRules.description: frontend/'s typescript-eslint crashes outright on TypeScript 7 (peer range is still <6.1.0, and it's a real runtime TypeError, not just a stale peer warning) — hold major TS bumps there until typescript-eslint ships TS7 support. backend/ has no such dependency and can update freely. Remove once typescript-eslint's peer range covers ^7.
Auto-merge everything — major/minor/patch/pin/digest — once required CI is green. CI is the gate, not semver.
